name: Aurelius Varsity Jacket
description:
A letterman-style varsity jacket with a white wool body and cognac leather sleeves — a combination that reads as timeless and deliberate. The ribbed collar, cuffs, and hem are in cream. A chenille letter patch on the left chest reads 'M88' in an old athletic font. The back has a large embroidered design: a stylized skyline of the Meridian 88 Spire rendered in gold and white thread, with the year 2198 below it. The interior is quilted satin in ivory.

Aurelius doesn't make these for a school or a team. They make them for anyone who wants to claim the city as their identity. Tier 3 and Tier 4 buyers pick these up as lifestyle pieces. Street kids on the Shelf save up for them or buy counterfeits. In some neighborhoods the M88 patch has been adopted as informal territory marking, which Aurelius has not commented on publicly.
what_it_says: You claim this city. Whether that's civic pride or territorial assertion depends entirely on where you're wearing it.
worn_by: people who grew up in Meridian 88 and never left
story_hooks: The M88 patch has been adopted by at least two rival street factions who each claim ownership of the symbol — wearing it in the wrong neighborhood has become genuinely dangerous
Aurelius made a limited run with a different back design — the Spire shown burning — that was recalled immediately; a few survived and are worth significant money to the right collector
A Tier 4 executive is quietly buying up every authentic Aurelius varsity she can find and will not say why
